info.description:
## Important notices
> - For the compatibility reasons in this documents utilize/utilization means the same as dispose/disposal.
***
## Webhooks information
> All webhooks described in this documentation are shown as callbacks for `webhooks-*`. Actually you can't subscribe for this method, as it does not exist - it is here just to render the docs. All webhooks will be sent to a single endpoint configured for partner (marked as `webhooks-endpoint` for documentation). Partner can later change the configuration of the endpoint via the API call or contacting technical support.
> 
> Webhooks consider delivered on any of 200, 201, 204 HTTP status codes. If the endpoint returns any other status code, the webhook will be retried later (up to 15 times). The retry intervals:
    > - one minute for first 2 times
    > - two minutes for next 2 times
    > - ten minutes for next 2 times
    > - one hour for all next times
***

schema.description:
Possibe additional error codes:
 * `registered_by_other_customer` - tracking number already registered by another customer
 * `customer_not_allowed` - customer not allowed to register tracking number
 * `error_track_too_short` - tracking number is too short
 * `wrong_tracking_format` - tracking number format is incorrect
 * `error_check_own_track` - tracking number is not registered by the current customer
 * `check_track_other_error` - other error, required attention from the manager
 * `delivery_type_error` - delivery type is not allowed for the current customer
 * `delivery_type_sending_error`, `delivery_type_sending_error2` - wrong gelivery type and allowed sending combination
 * `wrong_price_format` - price format is incorrect
 * `declared_price_too_small` - price format is incorrect

fees.description:
Information about applied fees for selected tracking number. Possible items:
 * `receiving` - payment for receiving to paid addresses
 * `return` - payment for return of tracking number
 * `shipping_for_return` - payment for shipping when return of tracking number happen
 * `paid_photos` - payment for requested paid photos
 * `checkup` - payment for requested checkup
 * `additional_packaging` - payment for requested additional packing
 * `storage` - payment for storage time that exceeds free storage time
 * `other` - non-classified charge
